_readme: Vulnerabilities documented + risk-accepted. See docs/SUPPLY_CHAIN_POLICY.md for waiver process. Each entry MUST have: reason (with reachability analysis), reviewedBy, reviewedAt (ISO date), expires (ISO date, max 90 days out). All entries below were reviewed + renewed 2026-09-25.

@firefly-exchange/library-sui.reason: BlueFin order-signing SDK. Server-only (BluefinService in /lib/services/sui/bluefin/). REACHABILITY: SDK signs orders using our own admin private key; inputs are typed BigInt/string from our own code, never user input. Vulnerable code paths are in the SDK's WebSocket/HTTP client which we don't invoke — we use only the signing primitives.

@mysten/sui.reason: Core SUI SDK. Server-only for transaction building + client-only for wallet detection. REACHABILITY: TX-building path takes typed args from our code; wallet-detection path runs in the user's browser against their own extension (self-attack). No untrusted server-side input reaches SDK parsers. Track upstream at https://github.com/MystenLabs/ts-sdks.

@mysten/dapp-kit.reason: Frontend wallet-connect UI. REACHABILITY: client-side only; runs in user browser. Vulnerable code paths require attacker-controlled wallet extension which is under user's own control (self-attack pattern).

@mysten/wallet-standard.reason: Transitive of @mysten/dapp-kit. Client-side wallet-standard adapter for browser extension discovery. Same self-attack reachability as parent.

@mysten/window-wallet-core.reason: Transitive of @mysten/dapp-kit. window.postMessage-based wallet connector. Client-only; runs in user's browser against their own extension.

@mysten/slush-wallet.reason: Transitive of @mysten/dapp-kit. Slush wallet connector (SUI's official web wallet). Client-only browser code.

@mysten/zklogin.reason: Used only in optional zkLogin flow (not activated in production community pool). If we activate zkLogin at scale, re-review.

@mysten/zksend.reason: Transitive; not directly invoked in our code. Track upstream fix in @mysten/sui.

@suiet/wallet-kit.reason: Transitive of @firefly-exchange/library-sui (BlueFin). We do NOT import @suiet/* directly (verified via grep across app+components+lib+agents). The kit's vulnerable paths are client-side wallet UI code that never runs in our bundle since we bundle only the BluefinService signing primitives.

@suiet/wallet-sdk.reason: Transitive of @suiet/wallet-kit. Same reachability as parent — no direct import; unused code paths.

lodash-es.reason: Transitive from multiple wallet SDKs. CVEs are prototype-pollution family. REACHABILITY: our code never passes untrusted input to lodash methods; SDK callers pass typed values from their own code. No server-side user input reaches lodash-processing code.

valibot.reason: Transitive schema validator from @suiet/@reown packages. REACHABILITY: validates typed messages from our own code paths; no untrusted external schema input.

ws.reason: Transitive WebSocket client from wagmi/@reown/@mysten packages. REACHABILITY: outbound-only WS connections to controlled RPC/wallet endpoints; no inbound WS server exposure in our stack.

@modelcontextprotocol/sdk.reason: Anthropic MCP SDK. ReDoS in the pattern parser. We do not accept untrusted MCP input at runtime — MCP servers are configured locally by the operator.

@hashgraph/sdk.reason: Hedera SDK — required for HCS audit trail submits. CVEs are in transitive protobufjs/grpc-js; upstream fix pending in @hashgraph/sdk v3.x. Server-only usage; no user input reaches the SDK's message parsers.

protobufjs.reason: Transitive of @hashgraph/sdk and @grpc/grpc-js. CVE is the prototype-pollution family — server-only; no untrusted proto messages parsed.

@grpc/grpc-js.reason: Transitive of @hashgraph/sdk. gRPC client used only against Hedera consensus nodes; no server exposure.
